approval_ref: Use Trunk Tools-style services as a reference so users can ask questions and receive answers grounded in existing project files.
notes: Extend the existing local current-Email header path to Cc, Bcc and Reply-To.
Support the only analyzed Email and one exact named .eml or .msg file.
Reuse exact citations, filename matching, conflict handling and passage caps.
Require ordinary answered Cc/Bcc/Reply-To questions to state the supported same-role value.
Do not expand distribution lists or infer delivery, readership, identity or authority.
Use synthetic evidence and make no provider or mailbox request.
title: Answer Cc, Bcc and Reply-To headers locally
objective: Return unambiguous Cc, Bcc and Reply-To headers from existing local Email evidence without model cost.
